design_philosophy: Elite, high-end, futuristic tech-force, military-grade HUD. Investor-ready dark mode iPad app. Total reliance on pure deep darks, electric teal accents, and monospaced data readouts. Asymmetric, left-aligned, heavy use of grids and raw UI data borders.

display.usage: Hero headers, major module titles (Vision™, Thermal™, Quant™), big numbers

heading.usage: Card titles, section headers, widget titles

body.usage: Paragraphs, general UI text, agent narratives

mono.usage: Data metrics, telemetry, coordinates, pricing readouts, HUD labels

rules.data: Always tabular-nums, tracking-tight, neon glows on active metrics.

layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped panels.
layout.alignment: Asymmetric, left-aligned primarily. Avoid standard centered layouts.
layout.grid: HUD-style rigid grids, 1px visible border-collapse borders between grid items.
layout.app_structure: Fixed top nav + sidebar/header HUD + workspace grid for dashboard.

hud_card.geometry: Sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Simulate corner notches with clip-path or pseudo elements. No rounded blobs.
hud_card.inner: p-6 relative overflow-hidden. Add subtle scanline grain background texture overlay.

glowing_button.primary: bg-[#00F0FF]/10 border border-[#00F0FF] text-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#00F0FF] hover:text-[#06080B] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300 font-bold
glowing_button.alert: bg-[#FF5500]/10 border border-[#FF5500] text-[#FF5500] hover:bg-[#FF5500] hover:text-[#06080B] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,85,0,0.6)] uppercase tracking-widest

step_indicator.bar: Horizontal segmented HUD bar. bg-[#10141D] h-2 w-full flex gap-1
step_indicator.pulse: Active segment should have a slow opacity pulse (animate-pulse)

agent_narrative_panel.style: Border-l-2 border-[#00F0FF] pl-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#00F0FF]/5 to-transparent

landing.hero: Investor pitch focus. Dark obsidian background with faint glowing grid. STRATEX Logo prominent. High-contrast typography. CTA 'Launch Fleet Command' with cyber teal glow.
landing.pillars: Three distinct HUD cards for Vision™, Thermal™, and Quant™. Hover effects trigger data scanline sweep.
landing.trailer_preview: Use the trailer engineering scene asset.

steps: 3: Macro-Edge Profile & Layer Analysis (Use Caliper Analysis tablet asset)
4: Quant Pricing Node (Use Quant Pricing tablet asset, show O&P lock & Xactimate tags)
5: Fleet Autonomous Launch Portal (Pre-flight check list with green/orange LEDs, large 'Authorize Aerial Reconnaissance' CTA)

live_dashboard.layout: Use Dashboard montage asset for reference. 3D wireframe placeholder in center, thermal anomaly minimap, agent narrative panels on right sidebar, pricing summary bottom bar.
live_dashboard.data: Live telemetry, Xactimate line items updating in real-time.

project_ledger.layout: Tabular data grid (Shadcn table customized). Fixed header, hover row highlights in faint teal. Status badges in Volt Green or Plasma Orange.

motion.scanline_sweep: CSS animation moving a semi-transparent linear-gradient from top to bottom over cards.
motion.glow_pulse: Subtle box-shadow opacity oscillation for active states.
motion.staggered_reveal: List items and table rows fade in with slight Y-axis translation, sequentially.

logo.usage: Main navigation, Hero section, Loading screens.

dashboard_montage.usage: Feature showcase on landing page, generic fallback for 3D/Thermal UI placeholders.

trailer_engineering.usage: Landing page 'Fleet/Trailer Launch' section background or hero image.

icons: lucide-react. Standardize stroke-width to 1.5 for precision tech feel. NO EMOJIS.

testing.rule: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

tech_stack_directives.components: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing/hero layouts. Use Shadcn components for complex interactive elements (Select, Tables, Dialogs) but strip Vercel-look defaults and apply HUD styles.
tech_stack_directives.forms: React Hook Form + Zod for Intake Wizard.
